Basic chat completion against real Google Gemini API

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"max_tokens\":10,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say hello in exactly one word.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gemini/gemini-2.5-flash-lite\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chat(req: _req)
debugPrint(result.choices())
debugPrint(result.usage() as Any)
```
